manifest.review: Main agent reviewed both Osprey versions, Kestrel execution, config/world changes and read-only observer. No hidden labels enter strategies. Review/tests precede runs.
manifest.contribution_definition: Per-stock sale proceeds minus purchase costs and trade fees, plus ordinary dividends and ordinary terminal value, minus starting inventory value. Excludes shared idle fees, interest and combo income; not account net profit.

plan.purpose: Validate earlier growth and the frozen Osprey holding overlay; no holdout tuning.
plan.seeds: 72001..72020 inclusive, one run per arm per world
plan.primary: On all worlds with a selected dragon, compare per-stock contribution with early_control and early_old. Report paired mean, median and wins; do not select only successful dragons.
plan.screen: For each comparator separately: positive paired mean and median, and wins in at least 60% of dragon worlds. This is a practical research screen, not statistical significance or a guarantee.
plan.secondary: Total account returns, percentile, exposure, ordinary dividends, no-dragon returns; no requirement to beat baseline in no-dragon worlds.
plan.world_change: Compare late_old vs early_old, same old strategy and exogenous seeds. Report price/dividend peak multiples, total cash-flow opportunity, quality checks. Multithread prices are not deterministic.
plan.decision: Retain all results including failed development variants. Do not add research Osprey to background during this test. Passing one comparator does not mean passing the other. Do not tune on these holdout results.

contribution_clarification: Frozen manifest wording "excludes shared idle fees" is shorthand: cash idle fees are excluded, but inventory burned for stock-paid idle fees is already reflected in stock contribution. Do not subtract stock-paid idle fees again. All 80 per-stock ledgers reconcile to account net profit after adding combo cash flows/terminal value and deducting cash idle fees/interest, plus any debt write-off.
